title: eludite.file.save_as input
description: File > Save As: write a text document to a new path and retarget its tab to it. Without new_path the UI shows the save dialog.

path.description: The document: an open file's absolute path, or a path relative to the workspace; the active document when omitted.

new_path.description: Where to write: absolute, or relative to the workspace.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at new_path (the dialog asks).
